bio.text: Javier Mabrey, a Democrat, has represented District 1 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, he advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Mabrey earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Colorado Boulder in 2016 and a J.D. from the University of California, Berkeley in 2019.
His career experience includes working as an attorney with the COVID-19 Eviction Defense Project and Faegre Drinker.
